# Reproducibility and Failure-Semantics Requirements Checklist: PAS-M1-001 - Base simulator

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements in spec.md: are the reproducibility, verification and failure-semantics requirements complete, clear, consistent and measurable before planning?
**Created**: 2026-10-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Project context: under Code SOP v2 this is a diagnostic only. It is not an approval gate, and `$speckit-implement` is not blocked by unchecked markers (`docs/code/SPEC_KIT_WORKFLOW.md` §3). Findings are resolved in spec.md and plan.md; see Notes. Depth: standard. Focus: (1) reproducibility and verification, (2) failure and interface semantics. Questions were skipped and the skill's documented defaults used.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Is "same machine and build" defined precisely enough (which identities make two builds the same) for the replay and restore identity claims? [Gap, Spec §AC-011, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are the parts of world state that a save must capture enumerated well enough to test that none is missing (including solver warm-start data that affects bit-exact continuation)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §AC-012]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is it specified which measurements count as "standard measurements" requiring independent recomputation? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK004 - Do the requirements say what the reruns across engine settings and assumed values vary, and when a rerun result makes a check fail rather than only being reported? [Gap, Spec §FR-009, §AC-009]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are the conditions that trigger physics sanity watchdogs specified (for example non-finite state and declared bounds) so that a watchdog check is testable? [Clarity, Spec §AC-009]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are the "declared limits" for confined component code (time, memory, processes) and the outcome when they are exceeded specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, §AC-004]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the readiness item list for the doctor command defined, or is its owner (plan) identified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are the minimum-provenance fields listed exhaustively enough to test "all fields non-empty"? [Completeness, Spec §AC-014; IF-001 `provenance`]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the declared data directory's declaration mechanism (where it is declared, what happens when it is missing or inside the repository) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK010 - Is each comparison rule (replay, restore-and-continue, branch, fresh checkout) stated with what is compared and what counts as equal? [Clarity, Spec §AC-011, §AC-017]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "a real model-route request" defined so that a mocked or cached response is clearly excluded? [Clarity, Spec §AC-001]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is "no other access" for the agent-only check defined in observable terms? [Clarity, Spec §AC-015]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are "excluded" and "missing" registry entries distinguished with definitions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is "no hidden files" for the fresh checkout defined in observable terms? [Clarity, Spec §AC-017]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 - Are the trial status names and invalid reasons identical across spec.md and IF-001@r1? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007; TASK §4]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the [confirm: 5] rerun sample count used consistently between FR-009 and AC-009? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK017 - Do the check-group requirements (FR-018) agree with the test plan's group list for phase 1, and is the split of groups between TASKs stated? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018; TASKS §3]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the 4 GB check memory cap consistent with the 6 GB WSL limit and the AI4R container's own memory envelope when both must run? [Conflict, Spec §AC-018, §AC-001]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 - Does every AC name a threshold or an exact expected outcome rather than a quality adjective? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are the planted-defect counts and kinds for X1.3 fixed before running (N ≥ 5, independent)? [Measurability, Spec §AC-005]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is the experiment size for the runner-design check (arms, factors, conditions, replicates, episodes) fixed so the expected trial set is computable independently? [Measurability, Spec §AC-006]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are the degraded doctor set-ups (at least three) named or delegated to plan with a selection rule? [Measurability, Spec §AC-016]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 - Are recovery scenarios that belong to later TASKs (crash, restart, model failures) explicitly excluded with their owners named? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is cancellation during validation or before the first trial covered, not only mid-trial? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §AC-007]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is the behavior specified when the same experiment is replayed on a different build (identity not claimed)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 - Are zero-trial designs (for example zero replicates) addressed as validation findings? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the behavior specified when a checkpoint is requested at a point that is not declared in the procedure? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-012]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK028 - Are resource-record fields and units specified identically for runs and for `compute-log.csv`? [Consistency, Spec §AC-016]
- [ ] CHK029 - Is a speed requirement intentionally absent (record only, no threshold), and is that stated? [Gap, Spec §FR-021]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK030 - Are the owner actions needed for X1.1 (model-route sign-in) and AC-010 (tolerance confirmation) recorded as prerequisites? [Dependency, Spec §AC-001, §AC-010]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is the assumption that AI4R's app image builds and fits on the laptop recorded with its resolution path (A-13)? [Assumption, Spec §Scope and Assumptions]
